item.title: Video: Man Drops Wedding Ring 118 Feet Onto Ski Slope During Proposal

item.title: Colorado Town Takes Major Step in Purchase of Ski Resort
item.description: Nederland, Colorado approved a $120 million purchase agreement to buy nearby Eldora Mountain Resort from the Utah-based company POWDR.

item.title: Monterey Bay Diver Has Once-in-a-Lifetime Run In With Exceptionally Rare Ribbonfish
item.description: On December 30, Ted Judah saw a fish called the King-of-the-Salmon ribbonfish in Monterey Bay. It is a rare creature that's related to the oarfish.

item.description: Enjoying the spoils of a massive storm or a two-week stretch like the one Mammoth has experienced is like nothing else in skiing or snowboarding.

item.title: Skier Found Dead on Keystone Slope Identified by Authorities
item.description: A skier found dead at Keystone Resort in Summit County has been identified as 59-year-old Eric Baltz of Westminster, Colorado.
